class.name: MIDIEventNote
class.brief_description: Represents a MIDI channel voice event.
class.description:
MIDIEventNote represents a MIDI channel voice message, such as a note-on, note-off, controller change, or pitch bend event.
The event type identifies the message, while the note and data properties store its decoded data bytes. The meaning of these values depends on the event type.
For note-on and note-off events, note represents the MIDI note number and data represents the velocity. For controller events, note represents the controller number and data represents its value. For program changes, note represents the program number. Other event types interpret these fields according to their MIDI message format.

members.member: The first data value of the MIDI message. Its meaning depends on [member event_type], and may represent a note number, controller number, program number, or another message-specific value.
The second data value of the MIDI message, when present. For note-on, note-off, aftertouch, controller, and pitch bend events, this stores the second decoded data byte.
The type of MIDI channel voice message represented by this event. The value corresponds to the status message nibble defined by the MIDI protocol.

constants.constant: Unknown or unrecognized MIDI channel voice event type.
Note-off message, indicating that a note should stop playing.
Note-on message, indicating that a note should begin playing.
Polyphonic key pressure message, associated with a specific note.
Control change message, used to transmit controller values.
Program change message, used to select an instrument or program.
Channel pressure message, representing pressure applied across a MIDI channel.
Pitch bend message, used to alter pitch.
